description: This Java class represents the response to an 'OpenConnection' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing response data such as connection ID. The class is annotated for immutability and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: OpenConnectionResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to an 'OpenConnection' command, including JSON parsing, creation, and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of OpenConnectionResponse with specified connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object and headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the connection ID to a JSON payload based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the connection ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource path for this response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is of the same type for equality.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another response object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the response.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response.
